summary: He names members of Purnell's current band and says he played with Joe Darensbourg a long time.

blocks.x: If you go to the 36th and Gramercy, you probably can catch Alton, what the drummer play at the Diggsland? Uh... Elton Red? Elton Red. Yeah. He played in the band with Elton Red now.
Oh, yeah. Who else is in that band? Mike DeLay? Mike DeLay. Uh...
Joe Derensburg? Yeah. He is in that band too. Oh, yeah. Yeah.
Yeah. I played with Joe a long time, around here.
Joe Derensburg from Peyton Root. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah, he's a very... He played with Armstrong.
Yeah. Just before he came out, just before he started playing out there. Ah, I see. Yeah.
